name: Migrating Forces
description: The migrating recruitment buildings enable the recruitment of more diverse units and increases migrating nomads' recruitment capacity.

variants.name: Recruitment Tents
variants.short: Men will always fight for their way of life.
variants.flavour: The uprisings of the Palmyrene Queen Zenobia and, later, Mavia of the Tanukhids drummed up immense popular support and anti-Roman feeling in the Levant and Near East. Mavia's campaign of liberation led her from Arabia through Palestine, and then down towards Egypt. Buoyed-up by Roman defeats, every town and city along the way was incensed to join her cause, and so the rebellion grew in strength. Furthermore, many Imperial troops who had grown up and operated in Arabic territory were also galvanised. As such, there were many cases of Roman soldiers defecting when they realised that the Arabic cause of freedom was more important than the fate of the swollen, corrupt Empire.
